dataset_safety: Never treat this fixture as a real person, bank account, bill, offer, partner or benefit.
Only .invalid email and 00000 phone placeholders are present.
No Aadhaar, PAN, bank credentials, card PAN, UPI PIN or real account numbers are generated.
consent: Household membership never implies financial-data access.
A personal or Commons data use requires a current explicit purpose-specific grant.
Revoked or expired grants must fail closed.
Commons demand signals may expose only service category, city/locality cluster, quantity band and price band; never raw transaction or income data.
cashflow: All money amounts are INR decimal strings with two fractional digits unless rates or percentages.
Only cashflow_treatment INCOME, EXPENSE and REFUND count toward cashflow; TRANSFER and IGNORE do not.
Refunds must be represented separately from purchases and linked through evidence where available.
A credit-card purchase is an expense; a bank-to-card payment is a transfer and must not double count spending.
benefits: All DEMO-* benefit programs are fictional and not government schemes.
POTENTIAL_MATCH is not confirmed eligibility or an award.
Applications marked SIMULATED are not submitted to an authority.
offers: net_benefit = discount_value + sponsor_credit - required_incremental_spend - fees - recurring_commitment_cost.
Reject any offer with net benefit <= 0 or unresolved material conditions.
Do not optimize for commission at the expense of customer net value.
commons: Only a customer with active COMMONS_DEMAND_AGGREGATION consent can contribute a signal.
Aggregate at or above min_group_size before asking providers for a group quote.
Provider-facing signals contain no raw financial transactions, exact income or individual identity.
A campaign is simulated until provider, price, terms and fulfilment are independently verified.
agent_workflows: Persist step state and checkpoint hashes.
Use idempotency keys for side effects.
Resume only after verifying current external state; never replay a completed side effect blindly.
Consequential actions require an explicit human approval bound to the action, recipient, amount and expiry.
vivc: VIVC counts only realized, externally evidenced value less incremental costs.
Synthetic outcomes must remain verification_level SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_ONLY and cannot be reported as real value.
